gaps.fact: What KWV stands for, Koöperatieve Wijnbouwers Vereniging van Suid-Afrika, the Co-operative Winemakers Union: no chapter, card or question text expands the initials; the Dutch words sit only in the accept list of the paarl article question r-1e5bxjsc, which a candidate never sees, and its explanation glosses them as the co-operative winegrowers association.

None of the Court's six (Graham Beck, Mulderbosch, Hamilton Russell, Klein Constantia, A. A. Badenhorst, Eben Sadie) is the key to a Régionale or Village question; the one Cape producer question in those banks keys Kanonkop (i-gwhjzobg), which the Court does not list. Graham Beck, Hamilton Russell and Klein Constantia are keyed only by article questions (r-fh1prv9h, r-7sy77538, r-rswgddk7) that sit outside the scheduled banks, the Sadie Family only by r-920s3p27 and the Premier Cru bank, Badenhorst only in the swartland article's producer list, and Mulderbosch appears nowhere in the Codex.

Phylloxera (1886) and the Anglo-Boer War, and apartheid with its effect on exports: the Boer War appears nowhere in the Codex, phylloxera only in the country overview, and apartheid only in a chapter clause; no question asks any of the three.

The Court's selling line, Cape wines from sparkling to light and crisp to rich and intense, offered as world class wine from an undervalued area: no question or chapter fact frames South Africa as the value recommendation or pairs a Cape style with a dish.

errors.claim: The Wine and Spirit Board runs the Wine of Origin scheme and certifies wines today.
errors.correction: The Liquor Products Amendment Act 8 of 2021 replaced the Wine and Spirit Board with the Wine Certification Authority, in force from 1 August 2023; the board is the historical name. The key of i-6kt4stwr should read the Wine Certification Authority (or name the board as its predecessor), and the explanations and labels should follow.
errors.source: Liquor Products Amendment Act 8 of 2021 (Government Gazette, 17 September 2021), section 2; SAFLII consolidated Liquor Products Act 60 of 1989, definitions with effect from 1 August 2023.

courtUpdates.now: The four tiers stand, but the scheme keeps moving: Central Orange River in the Northern Cape was reclassified from a ward to a district so that five wards (Groblershoop, Grootdrink, Upington, Keimoes and Kakamas) could be drawn inside it, and a Government Gazette notice of 7 August 2026 allows the words field blend on single vineyard wines and removes the definition of moscato, citing earlier amendments of 2022, 2023 and 20 March 2025. The search did not establish the date of the Central Orange River change. The certifying body behind the rigorous process is now the Wine Certification Authority (see errors).
courtUpdates.source: Search: SAWIS wine law notices (demarcations); Government Gazette notice of 7 August 2026 on gov.za amending the Wine of Origin Scheme; Liquor Products Amendment Act 8 of 2021.

notes: Mapped questions: Régionale 56 and Village 16 (South Africa), 72 in all. Outside the mapped cats, i-gwhjzobg (Producers & Icons), i-usb1vs12 (Dessert & Sweet Wines), i-ntu8ujmr (Sparkling/Fortified/Sweet), c-08hwfwkt (Sparkling Wine World) and i-le57zcor (Geography & Maps) touch the Cape. The subject is well served: the Benguela and Agulhas currents, the Cape Doctor, the Cape Fold Mountains and the three rocks, 1659, van der Stel and the Huguenots, the KWV from 1918 to its company form in 1997, the Wine of Origin ladder with its complete origin rule, 1973 start, estate, single vineyard, ward test and Boberg, the sustainability seal of 2010, every district the Court lists (Cape Town only inside i-ue2htdwz's explanation), Pinotage's parents and its Hermitage name, Chenin as Steen, Cap Classique with its twelve months on the lees, and the Old Vine Project's Certified Heritage Vineyards. The thin cells are the producer roll, the war and apartheid years, the KWV's full name and the Court's selling line. One error: the Wine and Spirit Board, replaced by the Wine Certification Authority from 1 August 2023, days before the guide, is still taught as the current body. House rule notes for the owner: the stem of c-cjl3ve9u sets its list between two spaced single hyphens (one after the words a code, one after new oak), which the dash rule forbids in spirit, and the stem of i-hpp5wmfo keeps the American percent. Two searches spent: Wine of Origin amendments since 2023, and the certifying body. Reviewed again in this pass, with no search left: every cited id exists in its stated category, the 56 and 16 stems were recounted, and the producer and KWV gaps were corrected after the article questions (r- ids) were read, since three of the Court's producers are keys there.
